title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Did you guys post anything about Harold Castro winning Detroit Sports Media rookie award?
Yeah, we posted a video on twitter and Facebook
I sent it in early and told them not to post it but then I saw they posted it and I didn’t see anything from the Tigers so I was furious
They didn’t send out a release?
I don’t get them. They told me to put it out at 11:00 so I assumed I needed to do that to match a release
